strata.provenance: pre-registered from Stage-1 pooled estimates, out-of-sample w.r.t. Stage-1B's new seeds; membership is FROZEN and candidates are never relabelled after results

nesting: For each seed exactly ONE master ScenarioSet of size 1000 is built; S=200 and S=500 are literal array prefixes of it. Independent build_scenario_set(seed, S) calls are never made, because they do NOT form prefixes.
correlation_caveat: S200/S500/S1000 are nested and therefore positively correlated by construction. They are NOT independent samples. Independent replication comes only from the distinct master seeds; the 100 cells are crossed-clustered (effective replication of order 10).
